description.value: Marine Gateway Liquor Store is a retail alcohol shop stocking beer, wine, spirits, coolers, and ciders, located within the Marine Gateway mixed-use development in South Vancouver. Operated under the Dublin Crossing brand, it offers local delivery to surrounding neighbourhoods including Oakridge, Point Grey, River District, and Richmond. Cyclists passing through the area could stop for packaged beverages, though no cycling-specific infrastructure is confirmed on-site.
